module_summary: Mux-based clock-domain-crossing synchronizer: registers data and enable in clk_a, double-flops the enable into clk_b, and loads the held data into dataout when the synchronized enable is high.

anchors.name: dataout
anchors.why: clk_b output register loading data_reg when synchronized enable en_clap_two is set.

anchors.name: en_clap_two
anchors.why: Second synchronizer flop output; enables dataout capture of data_reg in clk_b domain.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: clk_a-domain register holding data_in for transfer across domains.

anchors.name: en_data_reg
anchors.why: clk_a-domain registered data_en feeding the clk_b synchronizer chain.

anchors.name: data_en
anchors.why: Source-domain data-valid enable registered then synchronized to clk_b.

anchors.name: en_clap_one
anchors.why: First clk_b synchronizer flop of the enable chain.

groups.name: source_domain_regs
groups.description: clk_a registers capturing data_in and data_en.

groups.name: enable_synchronizer
groups.description: Two-flop clk_b synchronizer for the data enable.

groups.name: output_mux_reg
groups.description: clk_b output register selecting new data_reg or holding value.
